answer: An economy of AI agents resists Sybil attacks by demanding every identity periodically weave an original thread of reasoning with unpredictable seed words, graded by peers for coherence and novelty. This acts like a river gated at a narrow inlet: mass-produced fakes cannot all pass without expending equivalent unique generative effort per identity or facing rejection when templates appear. The attacker's cost is the continuous non-amortizable production of high-quality unique texts under time pressure, plus lost rewards and potential exclusion if patterns are detected.
